description.zh: 需要删除的应用的ID，可调用SearchTraceAppByName接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the application that you want to delete. You can call the SearchTraceAppByName operation to query the application ID. For more information, see [SearchTraceAppByName](~~130676~~).

description.zh:
应用ID。

在ARMS控制台的**应用监控**>**应用列表**页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，因此需要对pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为xxx%4074xxx，则需要将%40替换为@，即：xxx@74xxx。
description.en: The PID of the application. For more information about how to query the PID, see [QueryMetricByPage](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/186100.htm?spm=a2cdw.13409063.0.0.7a72281f0bkTfx#title-imy-7gj-qhr).
The ID of the region in which the application is located.

description.zh:
需要删除的应用的类型，可调用SearchTraceAppByName接口获取，更多信息，请参见**SearchTraceAppByName**。包括以下类型：

- `TRACE`：应用监控
- `RETCODE`：前端监控
description.en:
The type of the application that you want to delete. You can call the SearchTraceAppByName operation to query the application type. For more information, see [SearchTraceAppByName](~~130676~~). Valid values:

*   `TRACE`: Application Monitoring
*   `RETCODE`: frontend monitoring

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms delete-trace-app --app-id 540600 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --type TRACE --pid 9w0sc5gxxz@edcsd447c2f0000 --delete-reason '{"Remark":"业务场景覆盖不全","ReasonIds":[{"Id":0,"Name":"删除理由描述，ID和Name的对应关系：_id_:0,_name_:_功能不完善，无法定位到问题根本原因。_id_:1,_name_:_Agent不稳定，影响应用运行。_id_:2,_name_:_服务不稳定，经常打不开界面。_id_:3,_name_:_报警相关问题。_id_:4,_name_:_价格太贵_id_:5,_name_:_其他原因"}]}' --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms DeleteTraceApp --region cn-hangzhou --DeleteReason '{"Remark":"业务场景覆盖不全","ReasonIds":[{"Id":0,"Name":"删除理由描述，ID和Name的对应关系：_id_:0,_name_:_功能不完善，无法定位到问题根本原因。_id_:1,_name_:_Agent不稳定，影响应用运行。_id_:2,_name_:_服务不稳定，经常打不开界面。_id_:3,_name_:_报警相关问题。_id_:4,_name_:_价格太贵_id_:5,_name_:_其他原因"}]}' --Type TRACE --AppId 540600 --Pid '9w0sc5gxxz@edcsd447c2f0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
